title: Biden signs 95 billion dollar aid package including 61 billion dollars for Ukraine
body:
On 24 April 2024 US President Joe Biden signed a foreign aid package worth 95 billion US dollars. It included about 61 billion dollars for Ukraine, 26 billion dollars for Israel and humanitarian aid for Gaza, and 8 billion dollars for Taiwan. The House of Representatives approved the bill on 20 April by a vote of 311 to 112, and the Senate approved the combined bill on 23 April by 79 to 18. The funding had been stalled in Congress for months.

The Ukraine portion covered weapons including HARM anti-radar missiles and Javelin anti-tank missiles, plus their maintenance costs and other associated costs of US military support. About 9 billion dollars of the Ukraine aid took the form of loans that the president could forgive through 2026 depending on circumstances. The bill also gave Washington authority to confiscate and sell Russian assets and use the proceeds to fund Ukraine's reconstruction. The broader package also included a measure to ban TikTok in the United States.

Biden said shipments would begin right away. Kyiv Post noted that the aid was intended to ease Ukraine's ammunition shortage.
